drawer.player: The file of the player you picked. The sections hold everything you can do with them; the buttons at the bottom stay in every section.

tab.profile: Their data: IDs, job, money, condition and location. View only; it changes nothing.
tab.travel: Go to them, bring them to you, send them back, or move them to coordinates you type.
tab.health: Revive them if dead, heal them, or set their hunger, thirst and stamina yourself.
tab.money: Change their job and gang, and add money, remove it or set their balance.
tab.items: Give them items, open their satchel or wardrobe, or clear their satchel.
tab.moderation: Private message, freeze and spectate, kick and ban, and a link to their staff ranks.

sec.identity: The numbers and names that identify the player. The copy button beside each one copies it for you.
sec.work: Their job and gang right now. Change them in the Money & job section.
sec.money: The money they have now. Change it in the Money & job section.
sec.condition: Their health, needs and connection right now. Updated every two seconds.
sec.location: Where they are in the world now and how far from you.
sec.quick: The fastest ways to move between you and the player.

coords.text: Moves the player to a point you type. Leave Z empty and they land on the ground by themselves.

sec.restore: Brings the player's health and needs back to full.
sec.needs: Set their hunger, thirst and stamina yourself. They see the change on their HUD right away.
sec.job: The job they work and their grade, like sheriff or doctor.
sec.gang: The gang they belong to and their rank in it.
sec.cash: Add money, remove money, or set their balance exactly.
sec.give: Adds an item to the player's satchel.
sec.bag: Look into their satchel yourself or open the wardrobe for them.
sec.danger: Actions that cannot be reversed. Read before you press.
sec.message: A message only this player sees; nobody else does.
sec.control: Temporary actions: each one is lifted with the same button.
sec.kick: Removes the player from the server now, with a reason they see.
sec.ban: Keeps the player out of the server for a length you choose.
sec.level: The player's staff ranks decide what they may open and do in the admin panel. They are managed on the Ranks page.
sec.jail: Holds the player at the jail place for a length you choose, with a reason he sees. If he walks out he is brought back, and the time runs even while he is offline.

drawer.account: The player's RedM account name. One for all their characters, and different from the character name.
drawer.character: The first and last name of the character they are playing now.
drawer.discord: The Discord account linked to the player. Copy it to find them on the Discord server.
drawer.duty: 'On duty' means they are working their job right now; 'Off duty' means they are not.
drawer.bank: Their bank balance in dollars, apart from the cash they carry.

coords.text: Their spot on the map as three numbers X, Y and Z. The copy button copies it as vector3 to paste into a command or a file.

drawer.heading: The direction they face, in degrees from 0 to 360. The copy button here copies the spot with the direction as vector4.
drawer.openCharacter: Opens their character on the Characters page: all their data and property, with tools that work even after they leave.
drawer.goto: Takes you to the player's spot and closes the panel so you can see. They do not move and get no message.

bring.text: Moves the player to you. Their old spot is saved so Send back can return them.
bring.undo: Yes, with Send back in the Travel section

drawer.bringBack: Returns the player to where they were before you brought them. Works only if you brought them from this panel.

tpCoords.text: Moves the player to the coordinates written above. They notice the sudden move.
tpCoords.undo: They do not return by themselves; Send back works only after Bring

drawer.fillTheirs: Fills the boxes with the player's current spot so you can adjust it instead of typing it from scratch.
drawer.revive: Brings a dead or downed player back to life with full health, and fills hunger, thirst and stamina to 100.
drawer.heal: Fills the player's health, hunger, thirst and stamina to 100. For a dead player use Revive.

hunger.text: How full you want them, out of 100. 100 is completely fed; under 20 counts as hungry. Health starts dropping under the damage limit in the HUD settings (15 unless changed).

thirst.text: How quenched you want them, out of 100. 100 is not thirsty at all; under 20 counts as thirsty. Health starts dropping under the damage limit in the HUD settings (15 unless changed).

drawer.stamina: How much stamina (energy for running) you want them to have, out of 100. It drops again with effort as usual.

applyNeeds.text: Applies the values above to the player now; after that they drop over time as usual.
applyNeeds.undo: Yes, move the bars and apply again

drawer.refill: Fills hunger, thirst and stamina to 100 in one press.
drawer.job: The job you want to give them. Search by name, then pick their grade.

jobGrade.text: Their grade inside the job. Higher grades get more rights in the job's script.

setJob.text: Changes the player's job and grade now; they see the change on their HUD.
setJob.undo: Yes, set their old job back the same way

drawer.gang: The gang you want to put them in. 'No Gang' takes them out of their gang.
drawer.gangGrade: Their rank inside the gang, from new member to leader.

setGang.text: Changes the player's gang and rank now.
setGang.undo: Yes, set their old gang back the same way

drawer.moneyType: Which money to change: the cash they carry, their gold, or their bank balance.
drawer.typeCash: The cash the player carries, in dollars.
drawer.typeGold: The gold the player carries. It takes decimals, like 2.5.
drawer.typeBank: The player's bank balance, which they do not carry.
drawer.moneyOp: Add puts the amount on top, Remove takes it away, and Set makes their balance exactly the number you type.
drawer.opAdd: Adds the amount to what they have. Example: they have 100, you add 50, they get 150.
drawer.opRemove: Takes the amount from what they have. If they do not have enough, nothing is removed.
drawer.opSet: Makes their balance exactly this amount, whatever they had. You are asked to confirm because it wipes the old number.

amount.text: The amount in dollars or gold. Gold takes decimals; cash and bank are whole numbers.

drawer.moneyReason: Why you add the money. It is kept in the admin log, and it is required because added money comes out of the central bank reserve.

applyMoney.text: Carries out the operation on their money now; they see their balance change.
applyMoney.undo: Yes, with the opposite operation: Remove instead of Add

item.text: The item you want to give. Search by its name or its code name.

drawer.count: How many to give, from 1 to 1000. If their satchel has no room, nothing arrives.

giveItem.text: Puts the item in the player's satchel now and tells them they received it.
giveItem.undo: Open their satchel and take the item out

drawer.openInventory: Closes the panel and opens the player's satchel for you: see their items, take or add. The player sees nothing.
drawer.wardrobe: Opens the wardrobe on the player's screen so they can change clothes. Needs the character script running.

clearInventory.text: Deletes every item in the player's satchel for good. To confirm you type the citizen ID.
clearInventory.warn: There is no way to bring the items back after clearing

message.text: The message text. The player sees it as a staff notification for 8 seconds.
message.example: Please come to the Valentine bank

drawer.send: Sends the message to this player only, now. The log records that you sent one.

freeze.text: Holds the player in place until you unfreeze them. Useful while investigating or explaining.

drawer.unfreeze: Lifts the freeze so the player moves normally again.

spectate.text: Closes the panel and lets you watch the player up close while you are hidden. The player does not know.
spectate.undo: Yes, with Stop spectating or from My tools

drawer.unspectate: Stops spectating and returns you to your spot.
drawer.sitOnMount: Seats the player on the horse nearest to them. Useful if they are stuck or fell off.
drawer.kickReason: Why you kick them. The player sees it on the leaving screen and it is kept in the log.

kick.text: Removes the player from the server now. They can join again right away, so it is a warning, not a ban. They see your reason.
kick.undo: Not needed: they can join again right away

drawer.banReason: Why you ban them. The player sees it every time they try to join, and it shows on the Bans and suspensions page.

banDuration.text: How long the player cannot join. After that they can join automatically; Permanent lasts until you lift it yourself.
banDuration.undo: Yes, from the Bans and suspensions page

ban.text: Removes the player now and keeps them out for the chosen length; the ban is announced in chat to everyone.
ban.undo: Yes, lift the ban on the Bans and suspensions page

drawer.openRanks: Opens the Ranks page on this player, to give them a rank or take one away.

jail.text: Sends the player to the jail place now and keeps him there until the time is up. He sees the time left and the reason on his screen.

drawer.unjail: Ends his jail now and sends him to the release place.
drawer.jailReason: The jail reason. The player sees it on his screen and it is kept in the log.
drawer.jailDuration: How long the jail lasts. It counts real time, even while the player is offline.
drawer.jailPlace: Stand where the jail should be, then press here. It is saved on the website too.
drawer.releasePlace: Stand where a prisoner should come out when his time is up, then press here.

drawer.self: This is you: some actions do not work on yourself.
drawer.heading: Heading
drawer.noReturn: No saved spot: Send back works after Bring from here.
drawer.noNeeds: Hunger and thirst are not tracked for this player because the HUD script is stopped. Only stamina can be set.
drawer.previewShort: More than they have (%s), so the removal will not go through.
drawer.setMoneyText: They have %s now. After you confirm their balance becomes exactly %s.
drawer.clearText: Every item they carry is deleted for good and does not come back.
drawer.kickText: They leave the server now and see this reason: %s
drawer.banWhat: They leave the server now, see the reason every time they try to join, and the ban is announced in chat to everyone.
drawer.groupText: From '%s' to '%s'. The change is immediate.
drawer.groupHigher: Their level is the same as yours or higher, so you cannot change it.
drawer.ranksLead: Staff rights now come from ranks. Open the Ranks page to give this player a rank or take one away.
drawer.jailText: Held for %s and sees this reason: %s
drawer.releasePlace: Make my spot the release place
